name: Wrapped iTRY
oneLiner: wiTRY is a Brix staking wrapper that accrues yield over iTRY, exposure to a BVI-regulated Turkish-lira money-market fund and local TRY instruments.
collateral: iTRY deposited into the Brix staking wrapper, backed by a BVI-regulated Turkish-lira money-market fund and related TRY cash/liquidity instruments
pegMechanism: wiTRY appreciates against iTRY as fund yield is minted into the staking contract and vests over time; users can unstake through a cooldown or use Fast Redeem for a fee, while final TRY exposure inherits iTRY issuer and local-currency risk

reserves.name: Brix iTRY staking wrapper backed by TRY money-market fund exposure

mintAuthority.summary: wiTRY is Brix's yield-bearing staking wrapper over iTRY; the underlying iTRY is mint/redeem-permissioned to institutional participants on a primary market against a BVI-regulated TRY money-market fund, and Brix mints fresh iTRY via NAV-driven supply expansion that flows into the wiTRY staking contract.

controls.label: Brix issuer (institutional primary iTRY mint / NAV supply expansion)
controls.evidence: Brix docs/coverage state institutional participants mint/redeem iTRY on the primary market while retail trades permissionlessly; the protocol mints additional iTRY proportional to money-market fund NAV growth and routes it into the wiTRY staking contract.

controls.label: wiTRY staking wrapper (NAV accrual accounting)
controls.evidence: wiTRY shares appreciate against iTRY as vested fund yield is forwarded into the vault; the wrapper performs share accounting and does not itself create discretionary supply.

review.evidence: Brix materials describe iTRY as backed 1:1 by a BVI-regulated TRY money-market fund (Zodia custody, Accountable proof-of-solvency, Zellic/Code4rena audits), with institutional-permissioned primary mint/redeem and NAV-driven supply expansion locked into the wiTRY staking wrapper; iTRY is not a separately tracked Pharos coin, so this profile is authored self-contained.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Institutional-permissioned mint and NAV-accrual wrapper taken from Brix materials and coverage; the on-chain iTRY/wiTRY minter/owner admin and OFT adapter admin were not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain iTRY minter/owner and the wiTRY staking-wrapper and LayerZero OFT adapter admins across Ethereum and MegaETH.
